# City of Russellville, Arkansas

> > Official municipal website for Russellville, Arkansas, providing access to city services, emergency operations, public safety departments, and community resources.

This site serves as the primary digital gateway for residents and visitors to access city government services, including the Russellville Fire Department, Russellville Police Department, Animal Control, Planning Commission, and Parks & Recreation facilities. The city uses CivicPlus and CivicEngage platforms for citizen engagement, meeting agendas, and notification services.

## Key Topics

- Russellville Fire Department
- Russellville Police Department
- Emergency Operations
- Public Safety
- Animal Control
- City Services
- Fire Suppression
- Emergency Medical Services
- Patrol Division
- Planning Commission
- Standard Operating Procedures
- Agenda Center
- Special Event Permits
- Community Education

## City Services & Government

- [Services](https://russellvillearkansas.org/555/Services): City services directory including police, court, permits, and attorney
- [Agenda Center](https://russellvillearkansas.org/AgendaCenter): City Council and commission meeting agendas, minutes, and documents
- [Planning Commission](https://russellvillearkansas.org/214/Planning-Commission): Planning Commission meetings, agendas, minutes, and zoning info
- [Department in Action](https://russellvillearkansas.org/251/Department-in-Action): Public Works infrastructure projects map and street improvements

## Public Safety & Emergency Services

- [Emergency Operations](https://russellvillearkansas.org/551/Emergency-Operations): Fire department emergency operations: suppression, EMS, hazmat, rescue
- [Patrol Division](https://russellvillearkansas.org/221/Patrol-Division): Russellville Police Patrol Division emergency response and services
- [K-9 Unit](https://russellvillearkansas.org/574/K-9): Russellville Police K-9 unit with Max and Vinnie for narcotics detection
- [Fire Department Training](https://russellvillearkansas.org/188/Training): Fire department training for EMS, suppression, and special operations
- [Animal Control](https://russellvillearkansas.org/160/Animal-Control): Animal Control services, adoptions, lost pets, and ordinances

## Fire Department Resources

- [Professional Standards (Volume 300)](https://russellvillearkansas.org/639/Volume-300---Professional-Standards): Russellville Fire Department professional standards and SOPs
- [Admin Procedures (401)](https://russellvillearkansas.org/642/401---Admin-Procedures): Fire department admin procedures for permits and inspections
- [Community Classroom](https://russellvillearkansas.org/591/Community-Classroom): Fire station community classroom and training facility rental
- [Fire Prevention Month](https://russellvillearkansas.org/593/Fire-Prevention-Month): Fire Prevention Month activities and school safety education programs
- [Connect With Us](https://russellvillearkansas.org/610/Connect-With-Us): Fire department contact for permits, tours, and career opportunities

## Parks, Recreation & Community

- [Aquatic Center](https://russellvillearkansas.org/467/Aquatic-Center): Russellville Aquatic Center programs, memberships, and party rentals
- [Education](https://russellvillearkansas.org/277/Education): Local schools, Arkansas Tech University, and library resources

## Resident Support & Information

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://russellvillearkansas.org/FAQ.aspx): FAQ for police, fire, warrants, tickets, and municipal services
- [Notify Me](https://russellvillearkansas.org/list.aspx): Subscribe to city alerts and notifications via email or SMS

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://russellvillearkansas.org/124/Privacy-Policy): Privacy policy for Connect Russellville 311 app and SeeClickFix
- [Testimonials & Pictures](https://russellvillearkansas.org/162/Testimonials-Pictures): Animal shelter adoption testimonials and volunteer program stories
